meta.name: ai-security
meta.description: Use when assessing AI/ML systems for prompt injection, jailbreak vulnerabilities, model inversion risk, data poisoning exposure, or agent tool abuse. Covers MITRE ATLAS technique mapping, injection signature detection, and adversarial robustness scoring.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估AI系统对抗提示注入、越狱等安全威胁
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要检测AI模型的安全漏洞并加固防御
copy.tagline_en: Assess AI systems against prompt injection, jailbreak, and other security threats
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to detect and fix security vulnerabilities in AI models

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按本技能的方法评估 AI/ML 系统安全:扫描测试提示词中的注入/越狱特征,给模型反转、数据投毒等风险打分,映射到 MITRE ATLAS,并提出护栏建议。
howto.when: 当你要评估 AI/ML 系统的提示注入、越狱、数据投毒等安全风险时触发;也处理 ATLAS 技术映射和对抗鲁棒性评分。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude assesses AI/ML system security: it scans test prompts for injection/jailbreak signatures, scores model-inversion and data-poisoning risk, maps findings to MITRE ATLAS, and suggests guardrails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to assess an AI/ML system for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, or similar risks; also covers ATLAS mapping and adversarial-robustness scoring.

say_en.text: Assess this LLM for prompt-injection risk.
say_en.note: Runs a black-box scan with built-in seed prompts.

say_en.text: Run a gray-box assessment using prompts.json.
List all injection signatures with their ATLAS IDs.
